description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24): the ten items and the five response anchors of the paywalled pinned chapter BROOKE-SUS-1996, as open-access studies that administer it reproduce them. Each property names its source authority and locator.

item.description: Inferred from PMC-8600328-VITAAL-SUS-2021, Table 3 footnote, Questions (1) to (10), in order. PMC-9998603-IMMERSIVE-SUS-2021 Table 7 lists the same ten items in the same order.
enum: I think that I would like to use this system frequently.
I found the system unnecessarily complex.
I thought the system was easy to use.
I think that I would need the support of a technical person to be able to use this system.
I found the various functions in this system were well integrated.
I thought there was too much inconsistency in this system.
I would imagine that most people would learn to use this system very quickly.
I found the system very cumbersome to use.
I felt very confident using the system.
I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with this system.

responseAnchor.description: Inferred from PMC-8600328-VITAAL-SUS-2021, Table 3 footnote, 1: strongly disagree, 2: disagree, 3: neutral, 4: agree, 5: strongly agree. The 5-point scale runs from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree), per its Methods.

title: System Usability Scale (Brooke 1996)
